metadata.description: Planning and pre-merge quality skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Plan with clean code and modularity built in from the start (/lets-do), run parallel workstreams with an agent team (/team-do, or /team-do-pr for one PR per workstream), then run the full pre-merge quality chain end to end (/quality-suite, or /quality-suite-lite for small changes).
